name: Wps-office
tagline: A lightweight, feature-rich comprehensive office suite with high compatibility. As a handy and professional office software, WPS Office allows you to edit files in Writer, Presentation, Spreadsheet, and PDF to improve your work efficiency.
description: WPS Office is a lightweight, feature-rich comprehensive office suite with high compatibility. As a handy and professional office software, WPS Office allows you to edit files in Writer, Presentation, Spreadsheet, and PDF to improve your work efficiency.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/wps-office:11.1.0@sha256:8f0def94065abee8ef8aaf28744b341f7b599eb97fff9daf234ef6ff810aa6d2
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
